Definition: from G1636; an olive-orchard, i.e. (specially) the Mount of Olives:--Olivet.
BiblicalUsage: elaiṓn is a plain word for the Mount of Olives. In Acts 1:12, the text says "Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, elaiṓn, I take at face value: the Mount of Olives.
RelatedTopics: Nature and Creation; Jesus Christ; Prophecy
